text:
Dear Mr. Fujimoto,

My credit score is lower than you may like because my credit history is short. I just started working three years ago, and I only opened my first credit card last year.

I have always paid my rent and my phone bill on time every month. To build my credit, I keep a small balance on my card, pay it off in full with autopay, and follow a written budget.

I promise to make every loan payment on time, and I will be a reliable borrower. Thank you for understanding.

Respectfully,
Kanoa Ching

note: strong: adult, explains a past mistake
text:
Dear Loan Officer,

I want to explain the late payment on my credit report. Two years ago I had a medical emergency and missed one car payment while I was in the hospital. Since then, I have never been late.

I pay my rent, utilities and phone bill on time every month. I now use autopay for every bill, I keep an emergency fund, and I check my credit report regularly.

I am committed to paying this mortgage on time and I take that responsibility seriously. I appreciate your consideration.

Sincerely,
Teresa Aquino

Dear Loan Officer,

My credit score is low because I am young and I just started building credit. I never had a loan before.

I always pay my phone bill and my rent on time. Now I am working on my credit by using a budget and setting up autopay for my bills.

I will pay every payment on time. I am a responsible person and I want to show you that.

Thank you for your time.

Sincerely,
Keala Domingo

To the lending team,

Thank you for reviewing my application. My score is under your usual range because my credit history is new. I moved here from overseas four years ago, so I had no history in the United States when I arrived.

Since then, I have paid my rent and my phone bill on time every single month. I am paying down a small balance, I use autopay, and I am learning how credit works through a class at the library.

I am committed to paying this loan on time, every time.

Kind regards,
Minh Nguyen
